subject: Grey out for multiple pages (maybe SocketJS token generation problem)

messages.author: f447dab477e2c4ef
messages.subject: Grey out for multiple pages (maybe SocketJS token generation problem)
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I have a problem, and I think that with everyone, who are working with multiple pages (yourapp/www/index.html without ui.R) in their app.

The app's first page is working, but others grey out before they are loaded.

I'am afraid that the problem occurs only with pages like: (http://spark.rstudio.com/yourapp/*.html).
For example when you type http://spark.rstudio.com/youraccount/yourapp/ in your browser, works like a charm, but http://spark.rstudio.com/youraccount/yourapp/index.html doesn't.

Pleae find an example error message below:

[Error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
http://spark.rstudio.com/medwatch/shiny/index.html__sockjs__/t=*/info

How can we fix SockJS token generation problem with multiple pages?

Any help would be highly appreciated.


With best wishes,

Laszlo
